purpose: Separate internal structural readiness, verified revised-PEP sequence coverage and teacher-facing publication readiness.

readiness_levels.internal_preview_ready: The card can assemble without inventing missing data and visibly carries evidence/pending labels.
readiness_levels.teacher_ready_with_caveats: Core curriculum comparison and teaching guidance are supported; unresolved details are explicitly labelled rather than inferred.
readiness_levels.pep_unit_sequence_verified: PEP revised-series grade/semester/unit placement is verified from the authoritative all-volume series table.
readiness_levels.pep_subsection_page_verified: Subsection/example/page claims are checked against a volume or teacher-guide artifact.
readiness_levels.research_pending: A factual claim required for the requested view is not sufficiently verified.

publication_policy: When PEP revised series is selected, Grade 1-6 semester and unit placement may be shown from the verified series table.
Do not infer subsection headings, exact example pages or teacher-guide objectives from a unit title.
Do not infer that every Chinese school uses PEP or that all localities adopted every revised volume simultaneously.
Keep national 2022 curriculum stage requirements distinct from PEP textbook sequence.
A curriculum-inferred misconception can be shown only as a possible misunderstanding/probe, not as research-established.
A direct empirical misconception source does not make the diagnostic question a validated test.
US mode must state Common Core baseline or a selected state; never render a generic nationwide US curriculum claim.

resolved_blockers.blocker: Revised PEP Grade 1-6 exact semester/unit sequencing
resolved_blockers.resolution: Authoritative publisher-authored Table 1 provides all 12 volume contents; canonical sequence and unit-concept mapping are stored.

highest_priority_blockers.impact: Unit placement is exact, but fine-grained lesson/example placement and teacher-guide objectives are not yet complete across all 12 volumes.

highest_priority_blockers.blocker: China official 2022 standard printed page locators
highest_priority_blockers.impact: Section locators work internally, but printed-page citation precision remains incomplete.
All concepts have probes; some exact reasoning-risk records remain guidance-supported or curriculum-inferred.
Stored Chinese/English wording exists, but classroom validation is separate from research completeness.
California/Texas overlays cover selected high-use concepts rather than all 121 concepts.
